title: Declined Renewal Payments on Unlimited Plans: Retry and Grace Schedule
content:
**Payments reference — Marlowe & Finch Unlimited renewal retries**

The following retry and grace terms apply identically to all six Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plans: Unlimited Standard Monthly, Unlimited Student Annual, Unlimited Standard Annual, Unlimited Express Monthly, Unlimited Express Annual and Unlimited Next-Day Annual.

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Days on which a declined renewal is retried | The 1st, 3rd and 7th calendar day after the first decline |
| Most retries after a declined renewal | 3 |
| Grace period in past due status before the membership expires | 7 calendar days |
| Benefits while past due | None |

Points of reading:

- The scheduled renewal charge is the first attempt; the three retries follow it on day 1, day 3 and day 7 counted from the date of that first decline. The membership ledger numbers the scheduled charge as attempt 0 and the retries as attempts 1 to 3.
- Hypothetical timeline: a renewal charge declined on 10 March is retried on 11 March, 13 March and 17 March.
